name: Val
self_text: I'm an Australian man in my 50s who loves the focus of knitting. On PC, I mainly play Hollow Lantern and usually queue for ranked matches. I play a flexible role, so I can fill any position. I am free Sunday afternoon for games. No coaching.

requests.request_text: I need you to be into Hollow Lantern and you have to be available Sunday afternoon. I'd strongly prefer that you play a damage role or be flexible about your role, though it's not a requirement. Additionally, it would be nice if you are into ranked matches, but no big deal.
